summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (stdlib os/json only, full type hints, ValueError for all validation failures), exported it in monai/data/__init__.py, added the "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests, temp dirs removed in finally blocks). Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified. Lines are within 120 columns by measurement; black and flake8 were not run. No commits were made. Choices beyond the spec: non-object top-level JSON is reported as a missing key; invalid JSON raises ValueError; a non-list value under the key raises ValueError; returned items are shallow copies.
